law: Tiny tool-router picks intent + slots; mouth speaks canned multi-sentence copy with {slots}. No freestyle clinical chat. PHI on-box; no paid chat LLM on the happy path.

replies.clinical_advice:
I can’t give clinical advice, change doses, or prescribe in chat — that needs a visit with Dr. Brown.

If this is urgent and you feel unsafe, call 911 or 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).

Otherwise, book or message through the practice, or call {phone}.
replies.off_script:
That’s outside what I can handle here — I stick to scheduling, fees, forms, and practice info.

For anything clinical, please book a visit or call the office at {phone}.

replies.crisis:
If you are in danger or thinking about hurting yourself, please get help right now.

Call 911 for emergencies, or 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) for 24/7 crisis support.

This chat is not monitored for crisis and cannot keep you safe. You can also call the practice at {phone} for non-emergency office help once you are safe.

replies.need_pending: I don’t have anything waiting on a yes/no. What would you like to do?

replies.greeting: Hi — I can answer the usual questions (video visits, fees, insurance, cancellation) and help you book a new-patient evaluation if you’re in Illinois, Kansas, or Missouri. I don’t access medical records. Not for emergencies (call 911 or 988). What would you like to know?
replies.thanks: You’re welcome. When you want to book, tell me if you’re in IL, KS, or MO.

replies.hand_booker:
Here’s the booking link — pick a time that works: {book_url}

New patient evaluations are ~90–100 minutes ($600). Telehealth only for Illinois, Kansas, or Missouri.
replies.overview_then_state:
Thanks for reaching out — glad you’re here.

A few things most people like to know:

• All visits are online by video.
• Appointments are Monday through Thursday.
• New patients: evaluation visit (~90–100 minutes, $600).
• Follow-ups are 30 minutes ($265) or 60 minutes ($420).
• Cancel anytime; under 24 hours’ notice is charged in full.
• Out-of-network: HSA/FSA welcome. Pay at the visit; receipt/superbill for PPO reimbursement (check your plan).
• Telehealth only for Illinois, Kansas, or Missouri.

To book, I’ll need to confirm you’ll be in Illinois, Kansas, or Missouri for visits — which state?

replies.request_not_guarantee:
I can help you send a refill request for the office to review{med_clause}.

Important: a request is not a guarantee — refills are clinical decisions and are never automatic. Chat cannot prescribe or promise a medication.

If you’re out and in distress, contact your pharmacy or call {phone}. For emergencies call 911.

replies.hand_pay:
Payment is due at the appointment (or anytime before). Methods: FSA/HSA debit, credit card, ACH, or Bitcoin (visit-by-visit — not stored on file).

Fees: new patient eval ~$600; 60 min follow-up $420; 30 min $265.

If you have a pay link from the office: {pay_url}
Questions: {phone}.

replies.hand_join:
All visits are online video. Current patients use the waiting room: {join_url}

Bookmark it for easy access. If the link fails, call {phone}.

replies.hand_message:
Between visits, use this chat for general practice questions, or call {phone}.

I don’t access medical records and can’t give clinical advice here. For refill requests, say “refill” and the medication name. For anything urgent or unsafe: 911 or 988.

replies.new-patients: Yes — telehealth in Illinois, Kansas, and Missouri. New patients book a full video evaluation (~90–100 minutes). The first visit is a consultation; ongoing care begins after a second visit. Use chat for questions, then book online when ready: {book_url}
replies.hours: Visits are scheduled Monday through Thursday.
replies.approach: Dr. Brown does not provide ERP himself. He often works with people who have already done ERP or understand the ideas and still feel stuck — combining medication, dynamic therapy, and lifestyle support, coordinated with ERP therapists when you have one.
replies.after-erp: Yes — that is a common reason people reach out. When skills make sense but symptoms, sleep, mood, focus, or daily follow-through still get in the way, a psychiatry visit can help sort the next layer.
replies.directories: Dr. Brown is listed in the International OCD Foundation directory, and on Psychology Today for Illinois and Kansas. Links are on the About and OCD pages of this site.
replies.meds-therapy: Yes. As a psychiatrist, Dr. Brown prescribes and manages medications and also offers ongoing dynamic talk therapy when that is a good fit — not refill-only visits for everyone.
replies.insurance: Out-of-network for all plans. HSA/FSA debit cards are welcome. Payment is collected at the visit; you receive a receipt/superbill to submit to a PPO for possible reimbursement. Dr. Brown does not bill insurance companies directly. Contact your insurer for your out-of-network rate. CPT codes often used: new patient 90792; 30 min follow-up 99213 and 90833; 60 min 99213 and 90838.
replies.fees: New patient evaluation (~90–100 min) $600; 60 min follow-up $420; 30 min follow-up $265. FSA/HSA debit, credit card, ACH, or Bitcoin (visit-by-visit — not stored on file). Payment is due at the appointment (or anytime before).
replies.superbill: After payment you receive a superbill/receipt to submit yourself. Ask your insurer how they want claims filed and what your out-of-network benefits are.
replies.privacy: Personal and health information is stored with encrypted practice systems and clinical tools used for care. This website chat does not access your medical record.
replies.intro-call: Most questions are answered in website chat (same information as a typical intake email). The first appointment is a 90-minute new-client video visit — you can ask anything there.
replies.cancellation: You may cancel or reschedule anytime. With less than 24 hours’ notice, the visit is charged in full to the payment method on file.
replies.join-visit: All visits are online video. Current patients use Join visit ({join_url}) — that is the waiting room. Bookmark it for easy access.
replies.states: Secure telehealth for residents of Illinois, Kansas, and Missouri only.
replies.waitlist: If the posted times don’t work, use chat or call {phone} and the office can note what you’re looking for. Booking still uses the online scheduler when a slot fits.
replies.contact: Phone: {phone}. Fax: 678-392-1720. New clients: use chat for questions, confirm IL/KS/MO, then book online. Existing clients: Join visit for video; use site chat for questions between visits.

replies.desk_help_menu: Call, open, send, or book. Examples: call Jane · open Fuller chart · send Jane intake · book Jane Thursday 2pm. Yes / no confirms. Leftover English still goes to the model.

replies.ask_time: What time? e.g. Thursday 2pm or tomorrow 3:30.

replies.stub: Reschedule isn’t a one-shot verb yet — cancel then book, or use the calendar. Say help for verbs.

Confirm the call on the card, or say yes.
